Methods to Design A Layout
Mainly,  there are two methods that help to design the layout of the webpage
Flexbox
CSS Grid (Advanced & Fast growing )
slides.notes:
If we compare CSS Grid and Flexbox, CSS Grid is more powerful but it has got less browser support. 
So we use Flexbox

slides.title: CSS
slides.body:
Flexbox
Flexbox is a layout method that helps to arrange the HTML elements in rows (horizontally) or columns (vertically)
slides.notes: It provides for a better arrangement of all of the page elements that behave in a predictable mode.
